title: The ALMA-ALPAKA survey: II. Evolution of turbulence in galaxy disks across cosmic time: Difference between cold and warm gas
question: Does the turbulence (velocity dispersion) of galaxy disks evolve with cosmic time (z = 0-5) when measured from cold gas tracers, how does it compare with warm ionized gas measurements, and what drives it?

data.angular_resolution: ALPAKA: approx. 0.25 arcsec observations for 28 galaxies (17 used here)

what.value: Kinematic analysis (V, sigma profiles) of the ALPAKA galaxies, plus their stellar masses and SFRs

evidence.quote: Rotation velocity ($V$) and velocity dispersion ($\sigma$) profiles derived using
estimates of their stellar masses $M_{\star}$ and SFR (cite: Rizzo_2023)
we include the 4 galaxies from (cite: Bacchini_2020) with stellar masses

what.value: DYNAMO CO(3-2)/CO(4-3) kinematics of 9 galaxies, plus their H-alpha/H-beta kinematics

evidence.quote: for which H$\alpha$ or H$\beta$ kinematics are presented in (cite: Girard_2021)

what.value: CO(4-3) kinematics of two lensed galaxies at z ~ 1

evidence.quote: whose kinematic analysis from CO(4-3) is detailed in (cite: Girard_2019)

what.value: CO(4-3) kinematics of two main-sequence galaxies at z = 1.46 and 2.23

evidence.quote: with CO(4-3) kinematics presented by (cite: Lelli_2023)

what.value: [CII] kinematics of z > 4 disk galaxies (6 lensed, 7 non-lensed)

evidence.quote: we identified 6 lensed (cite: Rizzo_2020; Rizzo_2021) and 7 non-lensed disk galaxies (cite: Fraternali_2021; Lelli_2021; Roman_2023)

what.value: Main-sequence SFR prescription used to compute Delta_MS (Chabrier IMF)

evidence.quote: using the prescriptions recently published by (cite: Popesso_2023) and normalized to a Chabrier Initial Mass Function (cite: Chabrier_2003)
Their H$\alpha$ kinematics is presented by (cite: Varidel_2020)

what.value: H-alpha median sigma and V/sigma of z ~ 2 ULIRG and DSFG samples

evidence.quote: report median values of $\sigma$ of $160 \pm 60$ km/s and $87 \pm 6$ km/s for the ULIRG and DSFG samples, respectively

what.value: Gas scale-height profiles h(R) for 17 galaxies (4 low-z, 13 high-z)

evidence.quote: These profiles are presented and described in (cite: Bacchini_2019) and (cite: Bacchini_2024)
we show the profiles obtained by dividing the velocity from the local stellar TFR from (cite: Reyes_2011)

recipe.method: Select 17 ALPAKA disks with robust M* and SFR, add literature cold-gas disk kinematics with M* >~ 1e10 Msun; low-z: Delta_MS >~ 0.3; z >~ 0.5: at least 3 resolution elements along the major axis
key_parameters: Low-z selection: Delta_MS >~ 0.3 and CO kinematics (23 galaxies)

recipe.goal: Fit 3D kinematics of PHANGS galaxies and define sigma and V/sigma
recipe.method: Apply 3DBarolo to the public PHANGS 12-m+7-m CO(2-1) cubes; sigma is the radial average of the dispersion profile and V/sigma uses the maximum V

recipe.goal: Compute offset from the star-forming main sequence
recipe.method: Delta_MS = SFR/SFR_MS(M*, z) with the Popesso et al. 2023 MS prescription normalised to a Chabrier IMF
assumptions: SFR values from the literature are normalised to a common IMF

recipe.goal: Fit sigma-z and V/sigma-z empirical relations
recipe.method: Fit exponential forms sigma = a + b exp(-z0/z) + s and V/sigma = a + b exp(-z/z0) + s with a hierarchical Bayesian method
key_parameters: No U-Turn Sampler adaptation of the HMC step length
Wide uniform priors on a, b, z0 and s (Table 3)
assumptions: z has negligible uncertainties and no intrinsic scatter; measurement errors normal; data points independent

recipe.goal: Compare cold-gas kinematics with H-alpha samples
recipe.method: Compare medians of sigma and V/sigma from SAMI, DYNAMO, Hogan+21 and KAOSS H-alpha samples with extended-sample cold-gas medians in matching redshift bins and matched M* and Delta_MS

Compute sigma_exp,DI and (V/sigma)_exp,DI from Toomre-based equations with Q = 1 for main-sequence galaxies (M* = 10^10.5, V = 200 km/s) and for the extended sample with measured V and f_gas, then refit with the empirical forms
assumptions: Cold and warm gas sigma are similar (Wisnioski assumption); disks marginally unstable

recipe.goal: Compare sigma-SFR distribution with feedback models
recipe.method: Overplot K18 feedback and transport+feedback models on the sigma-SFR plane using K18 fiducial high-z parameters and the sample ranges
Fit log sigma = 0.33 log SFR + b with slope fixed at 0.33 (F21 energy balance), extending the hierarchical model to uncertainties in both variables and SFR upper limits
key_parameters: Uniform prior on offset b in [-100, 100]
assumptions: CC = [eps_SN h/M_gas]^(1/3) is approximately constant over cosmic time (CC ~ 1e-3, h ~ 200 pc)

recipe.goal: Predict sigma(z) for populations and V/sigma lower limits
recipe.method: Combine the sigma-SFR relation with the Popesso et al. 2023 main-sequence evolution, and divide the local stellar Tully-Fisher velocity (Reyes et al. 2011) by the model sigma
assumptions: At fixed stellar mass, high-z galaxies have velocities at least those of z = 0 galaxies (LCDM expectation)

recipe.goal: Test residuals of the sigma-SFR relation
recipe.method: Bootstrap datasets, Pearson correlation of orthogonal residuals with log sigma and log SFR, and partial correlation

score_reason: Catalogue, fitting code and PHANGS parameter files are public and the fits and regressions give numeric results, but the underlying ALPAKA and literature kinematics come from earlier papers and some run settings are missing
rediscovery_reason: Public catalogue and code allow redoing the sigma-z, V/sigma-z and sigma-SFR fits with numeric targets (Table 2, 0.77 +/- 0.03 intercept)
